title: Visible ores
description: Changes ores textures and makes them glowing, so you can see every ore in caves.
body:
**Visible Ores** is a minimalist, vanilla-friendly resource pack designed to make mining more efficient. By adding high-contrast, distinct borders to all ore blocks, this pack ensures that valuable resources stand out against stone, deepslate, and netherrack—even in the darkest caves. Never walk past a vein of diamonds again!

**Why use this pack?**

**Instant Recognition:** You no longer need to squint at walls. Each ore type features a uniquely colored, high-contrast border.

**Efficient Mining:** Spend less time "torch spamming" or meticulously checking every block. You can now identify veins from a distance.

**Vanilla Fidelity:** We have preserved the original Minecraft textures. The borders are subtle and crafted to match the game's art style, ensuring it doesn't feel out of place.

**Features:**
- Full Overworld Support: Includes all standard stone and deepslate ores.

- Nether Support: Includes Quartz, Gold borders for easier Nether navigation.

- Performance: 16x16 resolution textures. This pack has zero impact on FPS and works perfectly on all devices.

- Compatibility: Compatible with OptiFine, Sodium, and Iris.

**Supported Ores:**
- Visible Ores adds distinct highlights to:

- Coal, Iron, Copper, Gold, Lapis Lazuli, Redstone, Diamond, and Emerald (both Stone and Deepslate variants).

- Nether Quartz and Gold.
